WHAT WE DO

Civil works, finishing & green energy — under one roof.

From a single door to a full building, Classic Expert Finishing LTD covers painting and finishing, concrete and flooring, construction, waterproofing, landscaping and solar power across Uyo and Akwa Ibom.

01 / DOORS

Door Painting

Exterior Painting

Interior Painting

07 / CONCRETE

12 / FLOORING

High-Tech Flooring

14 / PROOFING

Damp-Proofing Services

Damp-proof treatments that stop rain-driven algae, mould and damp patches from forming on walls.
